falcon-theatre.mobility.1: Please notify the box office in advance if you require wheelchair seating or have special seating needs and our staff will be happy to accommodate you. Please allow extra time at the box office to enable our staff to comfortably facilitate your seating needs.
falcon-theatre.cognitive.2: Seating opens 30 minutes prior to each performance.
falcon-theatre.chronic.1: Latecomers will be seated at the discretion of the House Manager.
Should you leave the theatre during a performance, readmittance will be at the discretion of the House Manager.
falcon-theatre.mobility.2: Street Parking – Available on most main and side streets. Please pay attention to parking meters for effective times.
fitton-center-for-creative-arts.mobility: Four designated accessible parking spaces, each with access aisles Front-entrance curb cut Automatic interior and exterior door-open buttons at the entrance
Oversized elevator access to all floors
Two designated mobility-device-accessible seats in the theater (with companion seating)
Mobility-device-accessible bathroom stalls on first and third floors
High-contrast, large-print gallery signage With advance notice, the Fitton Center also offers tactile tours, including selected artworks and building features
fitton-center-for-creative-arts.cognitiv: With advance notice, the Fitton Center requires no class registration or enrollment fees for support workers to accompany/assist registered students during classes/workshops.
Galleries are periodically closed for the installation of new art, so please check the exhibition schedule before your visit.
please call 513-863-8873, ext. 110 or write frontdesk@fittoncenter.org
Calming Room Locations: Vine Street Village and Mai Thai’s Market
Sensory bags filled with oral motor chewy tubes, fidgets, noise-canceling headphones, sunglasses, etc. (Available for check-out at the Welcome Center)

cincinnati-zoo-botanical-garden.mobility: Vine Street Village 2 Sensory-Friendly family restrooms with adult changing table (31” off of the ground, can accommodate up to 400lbs; transfer board available in Welcome Center)

The Zoo offers a Courtesy Cart service for those with mobility concerns who need assistance returning to the front of the Zoo and is on a first-come first-served basis. This cart has a predetermined path starting from the Grove food truck area back to Vine Street Village.
The Access Pass is available for visitors who may have significant trouble standing/waiting in line at the train, carousel, Giraffe Feeding Experience, or Roo Valley. Using the Access Pass, visitors will wait the same length of time as the line, but outside of the traditional physical line.
cincinnati-zoo-botanical-garden.mobility: The Cincinnati Zoo is one of the oldest zoos in the nation, and was built on a hill. Please be advised that the Zoo has many inclines. We are happy to have many benches and rest areas throughout the Zoo, and any of our employees can guide you to paths that will be less steep.
Note: the train produces artificial chugging noises, an artificial train whistle sound, and will sound a bell at every train crossing. In addition, the train may produce loud grinding noises against the tracks. Guests with sensitivity to loud noises may become uncomfortable during the train ride.
cincinnati-zoo-botanical-garden.mobility: The Zoo has single and double strollers, manual wheelchairs, and electric wheelchairs that are available for rent at the Welcome Center, located in Historic Vine Street Village. We have a limited inventory and provide these items on a first-come, first-serve basis. There are a limited number of each item that can be reserved online ahead of time. Online reservations must be made at least 24 hours in advance.
Visitors with handicap/accessible placards will always be allowed to park in Vine Lot, even if the lot is full for other incoming traffic.
Visitors are welcome to bring their own food, beverages, and coolers into the Zoo! Glass and outside alcohol are prohibited.
The Visitor Experience team may be able to store medical equipment or a cooler for medical needs on a case-by-case basis.
Sensory-Friendly restrooms include manual flush toilets instead of automatic flush, and paper towels instead of hand dryers.
cincinnati-zoo-botanical-garden.cognitiv: Therapy or emotional support animals are not permitted in the Zoo.
cincinnati-zoo-botanical-garden.mobility: Vine Lot (Lot A) located at 3427 Vine Street – 20 dedicated handicap/accessible parking spots
Please have your placard visible to attendants when entering Vine Lot.
kings-island.cognitive.1: To provide equal access for all Guests, we have developed a program that allows Guests with mobility restrictions or cognitive impairments to access attractions.
Kings Island's Attraction Accessibility Program is designed to provide equal access to all Guests and does not provide immediate boarding onto attractions.
kings-island.mobility.1: Manual Wheelchair Rental Only $25 *Plus processing fees of up to $9.99 & applicable taxes. Rent a manual wheelchair for your visit to the park. Valid on the date selected at purchase.

Electric Wheelchair + Canopy Rental Only $65 *Plus processing fees of up to $9.99 & applicable taxes. Rent an electric wheelchair with a sun shade canopy for your visit to the park. Valid on the date selected at purchase.
kings-island.mobility.2: Guests with full arm (elbow restricted) and full leg (knee restricted) casts, or braces, are restricted from MOST rides and water slides at Kings Island and Soak City.
kings-island.sensory.1: If requested at least 1 week in advance, Kings Island will provide American Sign Language (ASL) Interpretation for live shows featured at our live entertainment venues.
Braille and large print copies of the Guest Accessibility Guide are available at Guest Services. There are a limited number of guides available on a first-come, first-served basis.
kings-island.sensory.2: White Canes can be used to access many of our attractions. White Canes may need to be collapsed and safely secured, stored, or left with a non-rider on attractions where they could be a hazard.
kings-island.chronic.1: Service animals are welcome at Kings Island.
A relief area is located adjacent to the restroom at Queen City Stunt Coaster.
Service animals are not permitted in water attractions, wet decks, wading pools, or lazy rivers.
kings-island.cognitive.3: Guests will present the IBCCES Accessibility Card to Guest Services upon their arrival at the park to express their accommodation needs.
Only IBCCES can issue the IBCCES Accessibility Card, and not Kings Island.
Information about where Guests access the ride is posted on each attraction's Safety Guide sign.
kings-island.cognitive.4: Due to the nature of most rides, service animals must remain with a non-riding member of your party. We are not permitted to take control of your service animal.
kings-island.chronic.2: Unopened and empty water bottles and baby food are permitted. No other outside food, beverage, or snack items are permitted in Kings Island.
Individuals who have special dietary needs due to a medical condition may bring small soft sided coolers to accommodate such needs.
kings-island.mobility.4: Get easy access to your car by parking right next to the Front Gate! Valid on the date selected only. Please be advised that there are no Preferred Parking spaces near the Soak City entrance.
